items.title: Benny Powell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I played drums in grammar school, along with Vernel Fournier, who is with Ahmad Jamal’s group.

ctx.x: We want to ask you some things about jazz, about some things maybe that young people don’t know today, and see if you can fill us in and tell us some things in your career that guided you along the way, and some aspects, I also want to talk about some aspects of oral culture. How old were you when you first started playing?

I played drums in grammar school, along with Vernel Fournier, who is with Ahmad Jamal’s group. I imagine I was about eight or nine when I first started playing drums. And this was just little parade drums.
What attracted you to the music? What drew you into a musical career?
